messages:
Priya (People Ops): Quick checklist for Matt's new PM (Riley) starting tomorrow — putting the essentials here so ops + manager can triage. Copy/paste as needed.

Before day 1 (today):
- Confirm Riley's full name + preferred email. (alex: need for console access)
- Device & badge: Jordan to confirm pickup window.
- Calendar invites: 1:1 (weekly), team standup, product onboarding, 30/60/90 sync placeholders.
- Manager intro email to the team with 2-sentence expectations + buddy assignment.
- Add Riley to relevant Slack channels and docs groups.

Day 1 (first 8 hours):
- HR quick intro (benefits, payroll setup). Sara to run.
- IT handoff & device setup (Jordan).
- 30-minute meet-and-greet with team (no slides).
- 60-minute product context + immediate docs walkthrough (PM mentor).
- Assign an easy first task: read the product spec for the last release + add one improvement suggestion.

Week 1 goals:
- Complete security training and SSO onboarding.
- Shadow 2 customer calls or support threads.
- Deliver a 1-page notes doc on product pain points observed.
- Set top 3 outcomes for the first 30 days with manager.

30/60/90 sample (paste into the 1:1 if helpful):
```
30 days:
- Learn product flows, complete onboarding tasks, shadow customers, own one small spec.
60 days:
- Lead week-to-week planning for one squad, run initial experiments and measure impact.
90 days:
- Own roadmap area and deliver a measurable improvement tied to KPIs.
```

Logistics & quick links:
- Benefits enrollment: https://hr.redwood.local/benefits (Sara)
- Device pickup: lobby desk (Jordan)
- Console access request form: /forms/console-access (Alex)

Matt (Eng Manager): Thanks Priya — I'll send the intro email now and set the 1:1 series. Buddy will be Lina from product. Can you confirm Lina's availability for a 30-min sync day 1?

Priya (People Ops): @Matt perfect. Lina said yes between 11:00-12:30 PT. I'll leave that slot open in Riley's calendar. Also tagging Sara for benefits kickoff. :thumbsup:

Jordan (IT): Laptop (MacBook Pro, M2) assigned and imaged. Badge encoded. Pickup at 10:00 tomorrow at security. If they need VPN tokens, DM me after they arrive.

Alex (Platform Eng): Adding Riley to staging + Redwood Console once I get full name and email. Also will add dev mailing list read-only. Matt — can you DM me the email?

Sara (People Ops): Payroll & benefits email queued. Riley needs to complete tax form + direct deposit by day 7 to avoid delay. I'll run the HR intro at 2pm day 1 (15–20m).

Matt (Eng Manager): Sending email now. Subject: "Welcome Riley — quick intros & day 1 plan". Copying Priya, Lina, Jordan, Alex.

OnboardBot: Created onboarding checklist for Riley (ID: OB-2234567890). Tasks added: device pickup, payroll form, console access request, 1:1 invite. Link: https://onboard.redwood.local/checklist/OB-2234567890

Priya (People Ops): Anything missing? If not, I'll close the pre-day-1 checklist and follow up in morning.

Matt (Eng Manager): All good here. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

Jordan (IT): One note — if Riley plans to connect personal phone for MFA, have them bring it to setup. Otherwise we can provision a hardware key on request.

Priya (People Ops): Great callout. I'll add MFA note to the onboarding email.

Alex (Platform Eng): FYI: for console access we need the user's GitHub handle too (for team membership sync). Matt please include it in your intro thread.

Matt (Eng Manager): Will do — adding GitHub handle in the email.

Priya (People Ops): OK closing for now. If anything changes overnight, reply here and we'll adjust. Cheers! :smile:
